searchText: Ah yep, definately mis-read this. thanks <@!194432762315407360> great you have added DPI resistance, it's definitely an improvement! Just read through the issue and it looks great ! <@!194432762315407360> Had a question on the DPI resistance, how much overhead due envision there to be in decrypting the masked header for each packet ? If the overhead isn't too bad, I think it is an acceptable tradeoff if we do get DPI resistance in return. I still need to measure it I have an implementation of the proposal 1 format in Go and it works Didn't implement proposal 2 yet because I was so unsure if it's even a good idea I'll implement it over the weekend and post some benchmark numbers Let's aim for a final decision on Monday If anyone objects to anything in the proposal, please let me know. This is the time to speak up and change things. Once we're all happy with the format, I'll go ahead and create the spec update PR. Some other minor changes are planned, but they're all tiny compared to the packet format change sounds good, looking forward to the benchmarks for this
